4 Issues migration tasks each touch a distinct file pair. task-023 (agent-roster-matrix) depends on task-020 because task-020 creates the Issues/per-agent-design-evaluation-gap/ topic folder.

3 independent file edits; no shared writers. task-040 depends on Phase 5 (documents now-deployed mechanism) but task-041 and task-042 are independent.

blocker_risks.concern: NFR-8 regression diff must be EMPTY against Phase 0 baseline (T2.6). ANY new finding line forces hard-block — Phase 3 must NOT start while diff non-empty.
AC-FR-8-d direct enforcement: Phase 3 commit-range diff MUST contain EXACTLY the 5 expected file pairs. ANY extra path forces hard rollback of non-migration commits in the range.

F-003 BLOCKER: frontmatter MUST omit `skills:` field. Verify via `grep -E '^skills:' .claude/agents/issue-capture-author.md` returning ZERO lines before commit. If `skills:` is present, Claude Code silently drops the agent's KB preload — the agent is functionally broken with no error message. This is the project's HIGHEST-PRIORITY task-level discipline assertion.
settings.json `permissions.allow` array MUST remain byte-identical to pre-Phase-5 state. Only the additive `hooks` block may change.
recipe-feature-pipeline/SKILL.md edit MUST NOT introduce any new pipeline stage, gate, or bypass language (AC-FR-12-b strict). One additive bullet only.
Pipeline-isolation grep (AC-FR-13-a/b) MUST return empty end-to-end. ANY match is blocker per Phase 7 Exit Criteria.
Final NFR-8 regression diff MUST be empty end-to-end. CPI-4 re-confirmation at acceptance.
No Issues/*.md file deleted by any /capture-issue invocation (CPI-5). Test issue from T7.1 must be restored via supersession (NOT delete).
